Hi Arielle / Tom —

Thanks again for the product + procurement sync earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you running the 30-day pilot and avoid surprises when you convert to paid: 

Key notes from call:
- You want to run a 30-day pilot across two feature teams (NLP extraction + semantic search).
- Primary procurement preference: PO, but evaluating Marketplace for faster procurement.
- Success criteria: performance on the eval set, integration stability, and usage economics.

Open items / asks for you:
1) Confirm procurement path: PO only vs card for initial signing vs listing on AWS Marketplace. If PO, do you have a standard routing (legal -> finance -> sign)?
2) Preferred billing start: do you want billing to start immediately after trial ends, or on first billable token after conversion?
3) Success criteria: please confirm which of these match your internal goals (we suggested below).

Our proposed trial-to-paid rules (suggested, flexible):
- Trial length: 30 days from pilot start (can be extended by request).
- Billing start: either trial end date OR sooner if usage exceeds 80,000 generation tokens in the trial period (whichever comes first).
- Conversion incentives: if PO is signed within 14 days of pilot start, we can offer a pilot discount for the first 3 months (we'll need procurement sign-off).

Suggested success criteria (example):
- Integration: API calls successfully integrated end-to-end by day 7.
- Traffic: 5k daily requests (or sustained 75% of planned traffic during two separate days).
- Quality: task-specific eval metric (F1/accuracy) meets agreed baseline on your test set (we typically see >90% for this workload).
- Latency: p95 < 350ms for generation endpoint under trial load.

Attachments: trial-success-criteria.docx (our template) and procurement-options.pdf (PO template + marketplace notes).

Next steps (proposed):
- Tom: confirm PO routing and estimated sign date (goal: PO signed within 14 days).
- Arielle: confirm success criteria above and whether you want billing to start on trial_end or first billable token.
- Sean: I copied Sean to propose any technical prerequisites for the pilot.

If it helps, we can also run a short procurement kickoff to walk through our PO template and AWS Marketplace mechanics — happy to schedule Monday/Tuesday next week.

Best,

Looping in a couple short technical notes so the pilot doesn't stall when traffic ramps: 

1) Networking / security
- If you plan to run in our hosted environment, ensure IP allowlist and API key rotation plan. For Dedicated or VPC setups, we'll need VPC peering and a short network diagram.

2) Ramp playbook
- Recommend a small dedicated pool for the pilot (2x A10G-equivalent workers) to handle peaks. We'll auto-scale but a dedicated minimum avoids cold starts for the first week.
- Provide a load-profile (attached) so we can simulate your 500 qps search peak and check p95 latency.

3) Observability / success gating
- We'll surface token usage, p95 latency, and per-route error rates in the Console. Please identify two routes you want prioritized for the trial dashboard (e.g., /api/v1/generate, /api/v1/embeddings).
